finding: Exact-commit GitHub Actions observation requires repository-level workflow-run enumeration with head_sha filtering, no event filter, and complete pagination traversal. A pull_request-only first-page connector response is not exhaustive evidence.

source_status.source: GitHub REST API workflow runs documentation
observations: head_sha narrows runs to the specified commit.
event is optional and must be omitted for all-event coverage.
per_page supports up to 100 and page-based pagination.
filtered searches can return at most 1000 results.
Pagination completeness requires following rel=next until absent.

uncertainty: No authenticated live private-repository enumeration was executed in this slice.

The GitHub endpoint documents a 1000-result ceiling for filtered searches; the implementation reports pagination exhaustion but cannot prove completeness beyond the provider ceiling if a single commit has more than 1000 runs.
falsification_route: Run the enumerator with an Actions-read token against a commit known to have push, workflow_dispatch, and pull_request runs.
Compare returned run IDs with GitHub UI and an independent gh api pagination traversal.
Inject more than one page and cross-commit fixtures; any missed matching run falsifies completeness.
Treat HTTP failure, page-limit exhaustion, malformed data, or provider ceiling ambiguity as incomplete coverage.
design_implication: Vercel Studio can replace the connector-limited workflow observation step with this enumerator, then pass only complete coverage into the existing fail-closed assessor.
